instructblip.prompt: Describe this image in 2 to 4 complete sentences. Pay special attention to readable text, signs, labels, documents, or words. Mention the object containing the text, where the text appears, and the surrounding scene or context that helps explain its meaning. Include any visible text you can read. Return only the description and do not repeat yourself.
